seo.title: Starter: build your site from here
seo.description: A mobile-first starter with UI8Kit primitives, data from JSON fixtures, dark mode and a mobile menu.

hero.title: Build your site from a clean start
hero.description: Every word on this page comes from JSON fixtures and the dictionary. Replace them, add blocks, keep the rules green.
hero.imageAlt: A sketch of a site page: a header, a hero and three cards

features.title: What is inside
features.description: A small set of parts that every site needs, wired the UI8Kit way.

items.title: UI8Kit primitives
items.description: Installed by the ui8kit CLI and never edited by hand. Compose them with the tag prop.

items.title: Data in JSON
items.description: Page content lives in src/fixtures, interface words in src/i18n. No backend, no API calls.

items.title: Mobile first
items.description: A responsive layout with an accessible sheet menu on small screens.

items.title: Dark mode
items.description: The dark class on html, saved between visits, the system choice by default.

items.title: Local fonts
items.description: Istok Web ships with the project as woff2 files under the SIL Open Font License.

items.title: Rules included
items.description: Cursor rules from ui8kit/contract and checks for raw tags, literal text and the 8+4 grid.

cta.title: Start with your own content
cta.description: Edit src/fixtures/home.json, run bun run dev and watch the page change.
